ios.desc:
Follow My Moves helps people learn and practice workouts with real-time feedback, creating an engaging workout experience that's fun for solo practice, parties, and social gatherings.

Practice With Full-Body Motion Tracking
Follow along with routines and see your movements detected and scored in real-time. Compare your performance, receive feedback, and understand where you can improve.

Learn At Your Own Pace
Everyone learns exercise at different rates. Follow My Moves lets users:
• Slow down routines to master complex movements
• Replay routines to have more confidence in movements
• Adjust practice experience based on their needs
• Become a coach and/or a student
• Pay for coach's packs and routines via credits that can be purchased

Create and Explore Routines
Create personal routine video collection
• Import videos from own device
• Record routines within the app
• Add your own routines for others to follow
• Explore and discover new routines shared by the community

Track Your Progress
Stay motivated as you improve:
• View routine scores
• Receive performance feedback
• Track completed routines
• Challenge yourself to keep on exercising and improving
• Keep track of users you follow and users who follow you
• See how your progress lines up with other users

Connect With Other Users
Share your routines, discover routines from others, and learn from others regardless of their location. Whether you want to learn trending dances and other routines, practice choreography and technique, improve coordination, get more exercise, or have fun moving, Follow My Moves is your personal workout app that allows you to start working out today at anywhere and anytime.

quotes.text:
Hey!  How is everyone’s workout lately? I’d like to show off a novel and fun way to workout and get real-time feedback from your phone, and with community support - This app is built by my daughter who started  this to help my wife’s post-surgery physical therapy, gradually turned into a workout/sport/dance-learning app - it uses your iphone camera to follow along with your moves in real time and shows you how close your pose matches.
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/workout-dance-for-all/id6765586514

It is genuine, easy, free and fun. Hope that helps with someone’s needs.

It's brand new on the App Store so any feedback is highly appreciated! Thank you folks for reading my post. Best wishes!
quotes.story_title: From physical therapy, dance to workout with real-time coaching
